notes:
Background: LucidPath builds an in-app onboarding copilot that guides new users through multi-step setup flows (interactive checklists, contextual tips, actions that call internal tools). Mid-market B2B SaaS (PM-led product org). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first; view Dedicated as next step if we can prove stable latency and cost.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (Samira) — product + infra present. Agreed POC scope: 2-week chat POC focused on onboarding flows.
- 2026-02-18: Security checklist sent (drive link). SE to run light SOC2 docs triage.
- 2026-03-01: Demo w/ streaming + tool-calling (Daniel). Showed function calls to calendar / user-profile service.
- 2026-03-05: Recorded deep-dive (ff_20260305_q1kjd9). Redwood team ran baseline hosted latency test on standard model.
- 2026-03-09: Pricing intro + dedicated sizing discussion. Requested committed pricing options.

POC & technical requirements / notes:
- Workload: low concurrency (peak 40-60 rps across tenants) but strict interactive latency for onboarding agent. Typical session = 400-1,200 tokens. Need streaming tokens to start rendering UI within 100-200ms first-token ideally.
- Latency SLO: target p50 ~120ms first-token, p95 end-to-end < 350ms. Cost predictability more important than absolute cheapest.
- Token cost caps: product wants per-session token budget and budget guardrails — cap at ~1,000 tokens/session; target cost per session <= $0.15 for median flows.
- Tool calling: must support robust function/tool calling with deterministic fallback when external tool is slow (timeouts, cached responses).
- Model preferences: prefer an open/reproducible model with strong streaming behaviour. Interested in Redwood-verified model profiles + quantized options for Dedicated.
- Routing & fallbacks: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant under load but with quality guardrails. Canary/A-B rollouts for updates.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdowns, per-route latency charts and tracing hooks required for SRE sign-off.
- Security: SSO/SAML required for admin console, audit logs for all prompts & responses, KMS integration for keys. Data residency: EU customers to be pinned to EU region.

POC milestones & results so far:
- Small hosted run (end of demo): p50 first-token 140ms, p95 ~420ms (observed spikes on cold cache). SE notes: large variance tied to KV cache misses and model cold starts.
- Action item: run dedicated-like baseline (warm kernels, steady-state batching) to show p95 improvement; customer expects <350ms.
- Cost test: rough hosted cost estimate provided; customer asked for committed pricing to compare against projected ARR.

Commercial & process notes:
- Owner: Samira (AE). Technical champion: Priya Shah (Head of Product). Decision maker: CTO (Oliver Grant) needs latency SLO proof + security sign-off.
- Forecast: April 2026 (internal expectation). Estimated ARR range $75k–$180k depending on Dedicated pricing and commitment length.
- Quote request: asked for 6/12/24 month committed options for Dedicated (sizing: 2-4 GPUs equivalent) + credits for Hosted POC.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "If we can get predictable p95 under 350ms with streaming + tool calls, we can sign for Dedicated." — Oliver, CTO.
- "Token budget per session is non-negotiable; we need hard caps and visibility in the console." — Priya, Product.

Next steps (short):
- Run POC 48-hour dedicated-like latency run (SE-led) with warm cache and batching enabled. TODO: schedule with infra team (Daniel).
- Provide committed pricing deck and example SLA for Dedicated (Samira to follow up).
- Legal: finish SSO/SAML questionnaire (linked_drive_docs).

Blockers (short):
- Legal sign-off on SSO + contract terms.
- Customer needs demonstrable p95 improvement vs hosted baseline.
- Confirm EU data residency path for EU tenants.

Misc refs: Jira for infra ask RDW-4671 (request for dedicated test env), security ticket SEC-229 for SOC2 doc follow-up.
